phases.name: Phase 1 — Automation Sprint
phases.description: Lead intake automation, Outlook triage structure, follow-up templates, renewal reminder prototype, tool/access review, testing, handoff documentation.

swimlanes.name: Ingestion & Routing (The Front Door)
swimlanes.focus: Web forms, Zapier rebuild, parsing incoming lead emails
swimlanes.goal: Data moves from WordPress/Email → EZLynx without manual copy-paste

tasks.title: Scaffold automations/ folder + automation-plan.md + automation-config.json (test mode default)
tasks.notes: Phase 1 has 5 stub workflows (lead-intake, email-triage, auto-responder, renewal-reminder, cancellation-winback) + EZLynx client stub + field map + test-mode guard. testRecipient = administration@lilacinsure.com. n8n hosting deferred.

tasks.title: Receive EZLynx login credentials from Conrad
tasks.blockedReason: Waiting on Conrad to send login

tasks.title: Audit EZLynx API access and activation requirements
Rebuild Zapier bridge: WordPress Gravity Forms → EZLynx
Test lead intake flow end-to-end with fake commercial + residential accounts
Confirm receipt of EZLynx login from Conrad's 2026-05-01 email
tasks.notes: Sent from administration@lilacinsure.com on 2026-05-01. EZLynx Support ticket #1943345 confirmed 2 concurrent logins enabled. Need to verify Adrian received the credentials email.

swimlanes.name: Triage & Task Management (The Inbox Engine)
swimlanes.focus: Outlook rules, categorical tagging, auto-responders, centralize tasks out of pinned emails
swimlanes.goal: Clear noise, surface high-value tasks (commercial submissions vs. billing)

tasks.title: Define email triage categories with Conrad (internal / DocuSign / renewal / commercial / billing / noise)
tasks.notes: 12 categories defined in categories.json (lead, quoting, onboarding, service, claim, renewal, retention, carrier-ops, vendor-ops, compliance, internal, noise). Weighted keyword scorer built and validated against 15/15 test fixtures. Needs Conrad review session to tune against real inbox sample before promoting to production.

tasks.title: Build Outlook rules for auto-tagging/sorting by category
tasks.notes: Live Graph runner (live-graph.mjs) built and working against administration@lilacinsure.com. Modes: --auth-check, --read (classify + print), --apply (classify + PATCH Outlook category tag lilac-<bucket>), --sweep (full mailbox report). Gravity Forms (Quote Request Form) wired: BCC to administration@, From Email = administration@lilacinsure.com, subject includes 'New lead' keyword. Live test confirmed: GF submission classified as lead (confidence 1.0). Remaining: schedule --apply to run automatically (Power Automate or cron); evaluate auto-responder next.

tasks.title: Set up auto-responder: lead acknowledgment email
Replace pinned email task system with proper task workflow
tasks.notes: Options: EZLynx tasks, Microsoft To Do, or simple Zapier-triggered task creation

tasks.title: M365 dev tenant + Azure AD app provisioning (Mail.Read/ReadWrite app-only)
tasks.notes: Azure AD app 'Lilac Email Triage' registered in Lilac's tenant (app ID 62f74641-9b98-462a-9922-67a66f43e319). Mail.Read + Mail.ReadWrite granted with admin consent. Application Access Policy scoped to administration@lilacinsure.com — Conrad's personal mailbox (cmilsap@) confirmed Denied. Auth check passes: token TTL ~60min. Env keys set in .env.local. Runbook: docs/operations/m365-dev-tenant-setup.md.

swimlanes.name: Document & Underwriting Data (The Heavy Lifting)
swimlanes.focus: EZLynx data mapping, Wonder Write ACORD alignment, DocuSign template cleanup
swimlanes.goal: Reduce repeated data entry for quotes and annual renewals

tasks.title: Map EZLynx data fields → Wonder Write ACORD form buckets (125, 126, 140)
tasks.notes: Requires EZLynx access to inspect field IDs

tasks.title: Prototype commercial renewal form pre-fill (transpose prior year → new year, update dates only)
tasks.notes: Primary time-sink for Conrad. RT, RPS, Burns & Wiltox each have similar renewal forms.

tasks.title: Clean up DocuSign templates: eliminate manual field placement

swimlanes.name: Lifecycle Automation (The Retention Loop)
swimlanes.focus: Trigger-based communications for renewals, cancellations, LightSpeed/Orbit integration
swimlanes.goal: Replace manual letters and Outlook pins with automated scheduled outreach

tasks.title: Build renewal reminder sequence: text/email replaces physical letters
tasks.notes: VoIP (LightSpeed/Orbit) can send texts. EZLynx has some built-in lifecycle triggers.

tasks.title: Build cancellation win-back follow-up sequence
Investigate LightSpeed Voice API for call transcription + auto-note to EZLynx
tasks.notes: Conrad's dream feature: call ends → summary + action items appear in EZLynx client file automatically

tasks.title: Add client service request widget to lilacinsure.com (policy change, billing issue quick-submit)
tasks.notes: Reduces email parsing burden. Routes pre-sorted service requests to EZLynx. Conrad was interested but wants privacy guardrails.

tasks.title: Competitor scan for Lilac Insure
tasks.notes: Pull together a quick competitor scan for Lilac Insure
tasks.routingRationale: Public-facing research (low privacy) requiring structured data gathering and analysis (moderate capability) over several hours (standard effort). Routed to closed-frontier/sonnet-4-6 (privacy=low, capability=moderate).

swimlanes.name: Operations & Handoff
swimlanes.focus: Phase 1 close-out — what Conrad receives at hand-off
swimlanes.goal: Conrad runs the system without us in the loop; we have a defensible 'done' line

tasks.title: Decide n8n hosting: Conrad's PC vs. Hetzner VPS vs. n8n Cloud
tasks.notes: Deferred decision D-1 in ROADMAP.md. Gates the final form of INSTALL.md. Default recommendation: Conrad's PC for Phase 1; migrate to a $5–20/mo Hetzner box he owns if 24/7 reliability becomes an issue.

tasks.title: Author INSTALL.md for Conrad (Docker Desktop, Ollama, n8n, env keys)
tasks.notes: Single document Conrad follows top-to-bottom to stand up the system on his hardware. Walks through Docker, Ollama pull, n8n container, env-key setup. Phase 1 deliverable #7.

tasks.title: Author OPERATOR.md (handoff runbook for whoever runs the system day-to-day)
tasks.notes: How to: trigger workflows, inspect logs, flip mode test→production, rotate API keys, run the discovery batch. Phase 1 deliverable #7.

tasks.title: Tool & access review summary doc
tasks.notes: Phase 1 deliverable #5 from retainer.json. Render stack.json + checklist.json access state into a 1-page audit. Conrad gets a single readable report of what's accessible, what's pending, what's broken.

tasks.title: End-to-end demo recording against fake accounts
tasks.notes: Phase 1 deliverable #6 from retainer.json. Record one full lead-intake → auto-responder → renewal-reminder cycle against M365 dev tenant + EZLynx sandbox. ~10-min Loom for Conrad.

swimlanes.name: Business & Compliance
swimlanes.focus: Hirobius-side prerequisites for client engagements at this scale
swimlanes.goal: Software-vendor legal posture clean before Phase 1 promotes to live

tasks.title: Lawyer call — MSA + SLA + light DPA template
tasks.notes: Tech-contracts attorney. Software-vendor scope (NOT data-processor). One template reusable across every Hirobius client. Estimated $2-5K one-time.

tasks.title: Bind cyber + E&O insurance ($1-2K/yr, software-vendor scope)
tasks.notes: Quote from Hiscox / Coalition / At-Bay. $1M coverage at software-vendor liability is the floor. Higher only if a future client demands. Block before Phase 1 promotes to live with Conrad.

tasks.title: Sign Anthropic standard DPA (free, online)
tasks.notes: Even though customers use their own Claude API keys, Hirobius needs its own DPA on file for internal dev/test usage. ~5 min at https://anthropic.com/legal/dpa.

tasks.title: Phase 1 invoice + retainer top-up
tasks.notes: Conrad confirmed checks-in-mail 2026-04-30. Follow up if not received by 2026-05-06. Issue Phase 1 deliverable invoice on close-out; refill retainer if continuing into Phase 2.

phases.name: Phase 2 — AI & Intelligence Layer
phases.description: Local/contained AI features. Privacy-first. No data leaves Conrad's trusted systems.

tasks.title: Local email triage bot: batch-process Outlook inbox, auto-tag by bucket
tasks.notes: Conrad's inbox is a goldmine of untagged history. A local Ollama/Hermes instance can parse and classify without external API exposure. Needs his explicit sign-off on data handling.
tasks.routingRationale: Local Gemma 4 26B (MoE, 3.8B active) handles email classification at the right quality/latency tier. Privacy requirement (Conrad's inbox) mandates local-only execution — zero external API exposure. No token cost.

tasks.title: Call transcription + EZLynx auto-note (LightSpeed Voice integration)
tasks.notes: Local whisper model or LightSpeed native recording + local transcription → structured note → EZLynx API POST

tasks.title: Commercial renewal form pre-fill automation using prior year data
tasks.notes: PDF/form field mapping + date update only + send to client for review/sign via DocuSign

tasks.title: Pro bono: inbox discovery report — one-shot Pattern A run on Conrad's real inbox
tasks.notes: First-client gratuity gesture. Pattern A discovery via discovery.mjs + live-graph.mjs against Conrad's mailbox. Local Ollama, ~$0 cost. Output: written analysis (composition, top senders, response-time baseline, lifecycle stages) as PDF + raw JSON. ~½ day after M365 access lands.

tasks.title: Pro bono: brand audit deck — render brand-audit.json as deliverable
tasks.notes: First-client gratuity gesture. 7 touchpoints from brand-audit.json + 3-5 quick-win recommendations rendered as PDF or Figma deck. Pure observation, no rebrand pitch. ~1 day. No client-data risk.

tasks.title: Pro bono: call transcription POC — Conrad's 'dream feature'
tasks.notes: Local Whisper + Ollama action-extraction on a single LightSpeed-recorded call → structured note. Demo-only (productionization is ai-2 paid). 3-5 day lift but signature gesture for first-client status. Per notes.md: 'call ends → summary + action items appear in EZLynx client file automatically'.

phases.name: Phase 3 — Agentic Command Center
phases.description: Conrad's own lightweight ops dashboard — not too tech-heavy. Status visibility, task queue, alerts. Similar to Hirobius Discord setup but simpler. Web-based, mobile-friendly.
